Service completion triggers upsell prompts.

Incomplete queries trigger contextual reminders.

High engagement triggers cross-service recommendations.

Branching Logic Overview
User Query
│
├─ Intent Recognized?
│   ├─ Yes → Route to Primary Persona
│   │        ├─ If pilot step → Pilot Onboarding Assistant
│   │        ├─ If pricing → Sales Advisor
│   │        ├─ If technical/automation → Technical Advisor
│   │        └─ Else → FAQ Bot
│   │
│   └─ No → FAQ Bot (clarifying questions)
│
├─ Sentiment Analysis
│   ├─ Positive → Continue normal flow
│   └─ Negative → Escalate to Sales Advisor + FAQ Bot
│
├─ Repetition Detection
│   ├─ Repeated 2+ times → Escalate Technical or Pilot persona
│   └─ Else → Normal flow
│
└─ Trigger Proactive Suggestions
     ├─ Pilot Step Complete → Upsell next tier
     ├─ Service Completed → Suggest complementary service
     └─ Open Questions → Prompt reminders
